method: Manual visual inspection with view_image of the final production-bundle fixture screenshots; modal entry animation settled and pointer moved off tooltips before capture.
observations: Chinese and English 1440px SSH preflight results clearly separate the failed systemd prerequisite from successfully discovered hostname, private IPv4/IPv6, interface names, SSH collection source, and sample time.

The host-details network section uses the same address table and shows SSH provenance while platform-observed source remains Not discovered; it does not turn an interface address into a public endpoint or egress.
At 390px, text and IPv6 summaries wrap inside the modal. The interface table scrolls horizontally for its remaining columns; the page has no horizontal overflow.
Final screenshots have no visible zoom transition, overlay tooltip, overlapping labels, or clipped source/time metadata.

legacy_hosts_nodes_fixture.reason: The parent run stopped at the first assertion, which still expects the old Agent-not-enrolled label; the run also recorded an unexpected host-labels request because the fixture does not intercept it. Static inspection additionally found stale monitoring/task-label tab labels, but the run did not reach those later steps. No claim is made about later uninstall guidance behavior. No production UI was changed to satisfy the fixture; this task’s two pure address-label edits to it were reverted.
legacy_hosts_nodes_fixture.replacement_scope: The new network fixture verifies manual SSH connection address input in registration and editing, read-only opening of both forms, preservation of host ID/user name/SSH target after discovery, and zero mutations except the explicit intercepted SSH checks.
